label: Rituals in caverns under Berlin summoning the Hitler spirit
description: Work going on underground again in caverns in Germany, in Berlin, where the same Hitler spirit and the spirit of the Antichrist are being summoned by satanic ritual, with a swastika seen, an object made for ceremonies, and a display said to be coming. Given alongside the repeated question of why they put CERN where they did.

label: The Kremlin struck and women and children fleeing Moscow
description: Seen 2 November 2025: women and children running from Moscow, and the Kremlin, described as looking like a castle, hit and blown up with strikes all around it. A named building in a named capital, which makes it among the most checkable war claims in the corpus.

label: A price on the head of a woman who exposes something
description: Given 28 October 2025: a woman has enough evidence to run with it, and because of what she will expose there will be a price on her head, seen as a price tag of over fifty thousand dollars. The following day the same figure recurs on a named official.

label: Underground trails through California to Las Vegas and Los Angeles
description: Underground trails seen running all the way through California, with Las Vegas and Los Angeles named. Cross-border tunnels near San Diego are documented; a network reaching Las Vegas is not.
aliases: all the way through Las Vegas
